title: Outcome
description: What actually happened, measured when the verdict came due. Stored as the frontmatter of a Markdown file whose body may note anything unusual about the measurement. Never edited once written: a correction is a new outcome pointing at the old one.

observed_value.description: The value as read from the source named on the verdict. Stored so that scoring never has to consult the live series again.

hit.description: Whether resolution.rule evaluated true against observed_value. The Brier outcome term: true is 1, false is 0.

corrects.description: The outcome this one supersedes. Set only when an earlier measurement turned out to be wrong — the earlier record stays.
